To set up your account so you can see a list of items you have checked out, starting with the date that you set the preference.

  1. Go to:  cwmars.org
  2. Go to: Login to your Library Account
  3. Login using your library card number and password
  4. Go to: Account Preferences
  5. Go to: Search and History Preferences
  6. Check the box next to “keep history of checked out items?”
  7. Check the box next to ” keep a history of holds?”
  8. Hit SAVE

Then, to view your “Checked Out History”

  1. Go to:  cwmars.org
  2. Login as in step 3
  3. Go to: Items Checked Out
  4. Go to: Check Out History

See new titles added to the SFPL catalog in the last 14 days.

To see new titles added to the SFPL collection in the last 14 days, go to CW MARS and click on the EXPLORE  drop down menu and click on NEW TITLES.

Once on the new titles page, scroll down and look for Shelburne Free Public Library. ( Middle column near the bottom). Click on it and you will be taken to a page in the catalog that displays our new titles. From here you can place a hold and read reviews.

First, go to cwmars.org

Click on MY ACCOUNT in the top upper right of the page. This will take you to the Login page.

You will need your library card number, which is located just under the barcode on your library card. And you will need your password. If you don’t have your card and password  any CW MARS member library can get your number for you and generate a new password, or you can request a password reset on the login page if you have your library card number. If you plan to use the online catalog you will need to keep a record of your account number and password or the system will remember it for you if you click the “stay logged in?” box.

If you need assistance call the SFPL at 413-625-0307 or email  sfplibrary@cwmars.org
